description: This file defines the HTTP routes for managing contact data in a contact management API, using Express framework. It handles CRUD operations and seeding of contacts, referencing external data functions.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all contacts.

methods.name: router.get('/seed')
methods.description: Handles GET request to reseed contact data.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a contact by ID.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new contact.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update a contact.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a contact.
